a j greer.det: Greer has been placed on IR with an upper-body injury.
a j greer.long: Greer took an unsuspecting hit to the head area from Ottawa's Nick Cousins in Sunday's 6-3 win. It's unclear when Carlsson will return, but he will be eligible to be activated from IR on Saturday against the Los Angeles Kings.

zach benson.det: Benson (upper-body) is out vs. Pittsburgh on Friday.
zach benson.long: Benson has battled through some injuries this season, appearing in every game, but will be out of the lineup on Friday against the Pittsburgh Penguins. The 21-year-old forward is having an excellent season for the Sabres, averaging 20:20 time-on-ice, recording 23 points (5G / 18A), 61 shots, and 29 hits in 25 games.

noah ostlund.det: Ostlund (undisclosed) has been placed on IR.
noah ostlund.long: Ostlund has yet to miss a game this season, but he will be sidelined on Friday with an undisclosed injury and will miss at least a week before he is eligible to be activated from IR. The 22-year-old Swedish forward is having a solid season for the Sabres, scoring 15 points (5G / 10A) in 25 games. Conor Sheary has been recalled from Rochester (AHL) in a corresponding move.

jonathan huberdeau.long: Huberdeau has been out since February 4th of last season with a hip injury, but appears to be inching closer to his 2026-27 debut after practicing the past week and being sent to the AHL for a conditioning stint. The 33-year-old Huberdeau has never lived up to his $10.5 million AAV, but his presence will still help a Flames team that ranks second-worst offensively in the Western Conference (2.43 GF/GP).

martin pospisil.det: Pospisil (concussion) did not travel with the team to Ottawa.
martin pospisil.long: Pospisil exited Saturday's 4-3 loss to the Chicago Blackhawks after just 7:57 on ice with what was later revealed to be a concussion. There is no timeline for Pospisil's return, but the Slovak forward has battled concussions in the past, so this most recent ailment poses extra concern. The 27-year-old Pospisil was having a solid season for the Flames, scoring 10 points (4G / 6A) and recording 113 hits in 24 games.

The 22-year-old defenseman, the Devils' 46th-overall pick in the 2022 NHL Entry Draft, spent most of the 2025-26 season in the AHL, where he tallied 19 points (1G / 18A) in 29 games with the Utica Comets.

alexander romanov.det: Romanov will undergo surgery to repair an ACL tear and miss 6-8 months.
alexander romanov.long: Romanov exited Tuesday's 5-2 loss to the New York Rangers after just 13:20 of ice time. He was absent from practice on Wednesday, and shortly after, the team announced that he would undergo surgery to repair an ACL tear in his right knee and miss six to eight months. The 26-year-old Romanov missed 67 games last season due to a shoulder injury and is likely to miss the remainder of this season as well, for an additional 81 games.

kyle palmieri.det: Palmieri (torn ACL and meniscus) is expected to miss the 6-8 months and the remainder of the 2026-27 season.
kyle palmieri.long: Palmieri's bad run of devastating injuries continued on Friday, with the Islanders announcing that he will miss the remainder of the 2026-27 season due to a torn ACL and meniscus. Almost exactly one year ago, on November 30th, 2025, the Islanders announced that Palmier would miss the remainder of the 2025-26 season with the same injury on his opposite knee. He had nine points (4G / 5A) in 23 games this season.

gabriel perreault.det: Perreault (lower-body) is expected to be out for the next 4-6 weeks.
gabriel perreault.long: Perreault, the Rangers' 23rd-overall pick in the 2023 NHL Entry Draft, showed encouraging signs last year in his rookie season, scoring 27 points (12G / 15A) in 49 games. That said, the 21-year-old forward hasn't taken the next step in his sophomore season, managing just 11 points (7G / 4A) in 24 games. He will be sidelined for approximately a month with a lower-body injury.

pavel dorofeyev.det: Dorofeyev (lower-body) will remain out vs. Chicago on Friday but is close to returning.
pavel dorofeyev.long: Dorofeyev has not played since suffering a lower-body injury at practice a week ago, but he appears to be nearing a return. After a career-high 64-point season (37G / 27A) in 2025-26 with the Vegas Golden Knights, the Rangers acquired Dorofeyev in an offseason trade and immediately signed him to a seven-year contract worth $11.0M AAV ($77.0M total). The 26-year-old forward's start with the Rangers hasn't been seamless, scoring just 12 points (6G / 6A) with a -18 plus/minus in 21 games. That said, he has been more efficient lately, with eight points (4G / 4A) in his last 11 games.
